title: Charles Wesley Godwin - It`s The Little Things

lines.l: The highs and the lows and the big things you go for
Ain't a weight you want to shoulder through your door
A smile and a wave go a little out of your way
Or hold in a door second more
A spare dollar from a billfold, it don't have to be so bold to make your own red-letter day
It's little things, like that first sip of coffee, like the sun rising on me, like the look she gives in the morn
I could go downtown, have a little drive around
And cruise these streets to some old song
It's a little thing that's for me
Restin' on your laurels ain't exactly what I mean
Don't let what you achieve mean everything
It's not as simple as I said and it never hurts to pray
Don't sweat the big pay, the big show, all the big things you want
It's the little things
Like that first sip of coffee
Like the sun rising on me
Like the look she gives in the morn
I couldn't go downtown
Have a little drive around
And cruise these streets to a simple song
Like a California red
Or lazy days in bed
The sweet things she whispers to me
It's the little things
Little things like that
It's the little things for me
Little things
Little things like that
I can't lie, I was born this way
Stubborn girl with a heart untamed
I'm tamed if you're asking, asking about me
